messages:
mara: Heads-up — we got a spike of ~2.8% SSE streams terminating with a proxy timeout after ~14s of inactivity. Clients immediately reconnect and we see duplicate token consumption. Console shows no quota events for the same requests. :confused:

josh: ugh. are these all going through the edge proxy or the regionless path?

mara: edge proxy, mostly eu-west1. Happens across 3 services but skewed to longer-running chat streams that are idle for short periods.

devin: can you paste a sample proxy log?

mara: here's an obfuscated trace: 
```
[edge-proxy] conn_id=abc123 route=/v1/stream event=idle_timeout reason=keepalive_miss duration=14.2s upstream=200 client=203.x.x.x
[upstream] req_id=xyz789 status=200 bytes_sent=12k
```

sam: looks like the proxy TTL is firing while client still expects the stream. Do we drop the socket or send a 204?

josh: current behavior: proxy initiates FIN without sending final SSE `event: close` frame. Client treats as abrupt close and reconnects. Billing counts tokens for both the original and resumed stream.

mara: i can repro locally with this curl incantation:
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/stream 
# wait 15s with no data, observe FIN from proxy
```

devin: can we confirm whether the kvcache/stream-resume id is preserved when proxy closes mid-idle? if id is lost, client will create new session and we double-charge.

josh: checked: resume token TTL is still valid server-side, but the proxy's session tombstone deletes bind on FIN and our routing layer treats reconnect as new session if resume token isn't attached immediately. so race window ~1-2s.

mara: so fix options: increase proxy idle to 30s (quick), send a `event: ping` before closing (nicer), or ensure resume token is sticky at reauth time (longer infra work).

sam: for rollout UX, we probably don't want to change idle globally for all customers. suggestion: add header `X-keepalive-grace` per-route and default to 30s for streaming endpoints. then patch console to show routes with grace window.

devin: also we need telemetry: add a counter `sse_proxy_early_close{route,region,close_reason}` and an alert when rate >0.5% in a 10m window.

mara: agreed. i can throw a quick hotfix to edge-proxy to emit the metric and backfill logs. josh can you draft the per-route header schema?

josh: will do. also adding `Connection: keep-alive` at the LB level could reduce FINs, but need to validate with infra.

ops-bot: deploy queued: edge-proxy-metrics-v2 -> staging. CI passed.

mara: plan for next 24h: 1) deploy metric patch to staging (mara) 2) add and test `X-keepalive-grace` header handling in proxy (josh) 3) patch console UI to show grace window (product followup) 4) add alert and dashboard panel for early_close (devin) 5) if noisy, rollout header default to streaming routes only.

josh: I'll open the PR for header schema and add unit tests for connection behavior. keeping small changes only for canary. :thumbsup:

devin: i'll mock the metric in the telemetry pipeline so we can query historic anomalies tomorrow.

mara: thanks all — leaving some logs in #eng-platform-dumps if anyone wants to dig further. :eyes:
